## Summary

Describe the change and the problem it solves.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] UI tested at mobile and desktop widths (if applicable)

## Security and privacy

- [ ] No secrets, private keys, seeds, or viewing keys added.
- [ ] Server-only credentials remain server-side.
- [ ] AI output is treated as untrusted and cannot independently release funds.
- [ ] Demo/simulated behavior is labelled accurately.
- [ ] URL fetching (if added) has SSRF protections and strict validation.

## UI quality

- [ ] Responsive layout checked.
- [ ] Loading, empty, and error states considered.
- [ ] Accessibility labels and keyboard behavior considered.
